scope: Ranks 11-20 review evidence notes. Browser/source pages were accessed as metadata only; no raster, vector, climate, or MODIS granule data bodies were downloaded.

claims.note: CDS full gridded product page states global regular lat-lon 0.1° grid, hourly, 1950-present, GRIB; configurable variable/date/area UI gives no fixed total download size. Separate producer time-series documentation confirms point/limited-area ARCO Zarr subset. For context only, one global float32 array variable for a 365-day year calculates as 3600×1801×8760×4 = 227,185,344,000 bytes (~227 GB decimal); this is illustrative uncompressed raw-array payload, not download bytes or archive total.

Public GCS JSON API object metadata listing for downloads2021/occurrence/ returned 504 names and exact size fields, no nextPageToken, 56,671-byte response; exact size sum 15,972,544,704 bytes. This scopes only the global 2021 occurrence layer, not all v1.4 products. The listing is preserved in evidence-b/gsw-occurrence-v1.4-2021-object-listing.json; TIFF bodies were not fetched.
UCAR RDA d093002 monthly CFSR products: January 1979-December 2010, WMO GRIB2, publisher total volume 5.05 TB. This is monthly-products scope only.

Source inventory in datasets/river-plastic-inputs/dataset.yaml and releases/figshare-v6-r2/manifest.json records Figshare v6 file PlasticRiverInputs.zip as 5,764,810 bytes (MD5 4b3167c75df6b1227839e6b1674d3cda); 40,760 rows. Local derivative asset byte counts are separately in releases/figshare-v6-r2/manifest.json and are not published.

Current NKN/THREDDS v1.1 catalog page lists TerraClimate_vap_2024.nc at 135.6 Mbytes (publisher-rounded), one variable-year compressed NetCDF4 file. Current producer page states v1.1 uses ERA5 anomalies and warns not to mix v1.0/v1.1. Original 2018 paper’s ~800 GB is only the uncompressed 1958-2015 all-variable v1.0 historical archive; retained separately.

Parent CMR evidence was independently checked: query reports 111 hits and 111 returned entries; 111 unique titles and granule IDs; all ZIP names are unique; every record has one data link whose description says GeoTIFF format; summed rounded per-granule granule_size values = 59.39 MB. Evidence response is evidence-parent/mangrove-granules.json. No granule bodies downloaded.

PRISM directory lists prism_vpdmax_us_30s_2024.zip at rounded 49M; only one variable-year, not family total. Current web-service docs identify COG; old official GEE collection is about 4.64 km and 1981-present, distinct from the chosen 800m source.
EPA lists US Level III shapefile with state boundaries as 35 MB and without state boundaries as 28 MB. Used only the with-boundaries package as a publisher-stated rounded size.

Public USGS ScienceBase item metadata JSON (24,144-byte response) lists gap_landfire_nationalterrestrialecosystems2011.zip at 1,998,043,721 bytes. The request retrieved metadata only; archive was not downloaded. Response is preserved in evidence-b/gap-sciencebase-item-metadata.json.

Parent evidence was independently checked: three CMR UMM pages returned 100+100+90=290 records, all unique granule URs/IDs; all records are MOD17A3HGF and begin/end in 2024. Summed DataGranule.ArchiveAndDistributionInformation Size = 2044.3589506149292 MB as CMR labels it. Native format supported by current LP DAAC V6.1 user guide, HDF-EOS2. Evidence receipts are evidence-parent/mod17-2024-page1/2/3.json and mod17-2024-size-summary.json. No granule bodies downloaded.
